description: Full-time, remote. My job is to automate as much of the company's manual work as possible. Built a Claude Code automation that cut JSM ticket turnaround from 2 weeks to 8 hours, removing a large overload from the team. Meanwhile migrating workloads from on-premises private datacenters to GCP.

Worked on the platform while it built brand-new infrastructure in AWS after the acquisition. Touching everything from designing IP subnets for all kinds of environments to operating the platform against proper standards.
Migrated the platform from VM servers where apps were deployed with git pull to a properly built GKE infrastructure.
First two years before DevOps, at the same company under its previous name. Built PHP applications, mostly in Laravel.

Before graduating school I landed a few first contracts: simple websites, a simple Unity game, a simple mobile app in Xamarin, a simple desktop app in Electron, and some bigger CMS projects in Laravel.
